rejection_summary.zero_MCSE_counterfactual: At saved point estimates every hard-evaluated candidate has at least one positive H×data/wave delta. Removing the uncertainty margin alone would still fail the per-H conjunction; this does not prove the underlying true expectation is adverse.

key_local_examples.finding: All three legal amplitudes pass native guards but fail energy with adverse3MCSE cells. Smaller magnitude shrinks harm without reversing signed data/wave means.

At factors.5/.25 all native checks pass and energy is unresolved; at.125 lower3MCSE becomes positive for slow data/wave and common wave. Smaller amplitude is not monotone improvement in signal-to-MCSE.
Mean across H of saved data/wave deltas is negative, while per-H conjunction still fails. It also adds one rise undefined/censored event in common_level.

Factor.5 fails native current-wave for all3H: +.262%,+.337%,+.277%; slow data/wave lower3MCSE positive. Factors.25/.125 pass native guards but remain unresolved; the8-to16 CHECK extension prevents attributing all change to amplitude alone.

One extra rise-undefined/prepeak-censored fake event:18/1024→19/1024. Extra rate.0009765625 is within Boolean allowance.001, while original positive-T rate-distance checks fail. These are different guards, not contradictory receipts.

adapter_expression.family: conditional monotone piecewise-linear time queries followed by linear interpolation of frozenA0 and a charge-coupled positive normalization
adapter_expression.network: 2→16→8,184 trainable mean parameters;8 free interval log-increments per conditional output, not a free waveform per event
adapter_expression.charge_definition: canonical_charge008=sum(signal[110:366]) on the fixed1ns grid; NOT the full384 sum and NOT noisy peak-recensored observedQ
adapter_expression.normalization: Qwarp/Q_A0>=.25, positive gain=Q_A0/Qwarp<=4; mean canonicalQ fixed toA0; prefix0:100 copied unchanged
expressible: conditioned front/tail compression and stretching within fixed anchors
same warp rule can act on different frozenA0 shapes
unavailable_in_this_mean_phase: independent canonical mean-charge or global voltage-gain learning
arbitrary additive smooth residual or new ringing feature
free translation of the126 mapping anchor
new local noise, electronics or stochastic covariance; originalM0 basis remains fixed with charge off
adapter_expression.observation_boundary: ADC, noise and argmax-dependent256crop can change observedQ/PSD although fixed canonical110:366 meanQ is conserved
adapter_expression.evidence_limit: These are algebraic family limits. Six sampled directions do not establish that this family cannot fit legal REAL TRAIN; the user work order requires an expressivity fit before adding a restricted residual.

hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.fact: FIT averages H energy(wave six-view mean+2integral) and small regularization. CHECK requires each H data and wave3MCSE improvement and native W1/positiveT/anomaly/negative-area guards.
hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.implication: Average-objective improvement does not imply every-H improvement or native-W1 agreement; this gap exists even with an exact differentiable observation and is not solely an STE issue.

hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.location: FIT versus TRAIN_CHECK independent bank namespaces
hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.fact: FIT pre-proposal means are on refreshed banks; CHECK uses independent CRN banks across old/candidate. All REAL0 candidates revert to the sameM0.
hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.implication: Different FIT loss levels across five rows are sampling variation at the unchanged accepted model, not a learning curve. No saved post-proposal FIT score or matching-bank directional derivative establishes descent.

hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.fact: STE and hard have identical rounded/clamped forward values. STE backward is identity inside ADC range and clamp-zero outside; the true hard quantizer is locally piecewise constant.
hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.implication: Finite amplitude hard risk can disagree with the surrogate directional derivative; saved logs lack a same-bank derivative comparison, so causality is unproven.

hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.fact: First-argmax integer search and crop indices have no gradient; selected values have gather gradients.
hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.implication: A proposal can switch noisy peak index/crop/windowQ/PSD or flag counts discontinuously; backpropagation follows the current crop and does not predict the index switch.

hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.fact: Peak-normalized wave views use hard amax/clamp; integral features are asinh of fixed observed-window integrals.
hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.implication: Winner changes and ADC/crop jumps can change local geometry. No claim that saved failures isolate this mechanism.

hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.fact: Base scale estimates radius from the unscaled pure-signal probe; the adapter is nonlinear. Saved factor1 RMS exceeds radius by.193–.249%, while factors.5/.25/.125 pass.
hard_STE_and_objective_boundaries.implication: The top amplitude can be clipped by nonlinear response scaling, but removing this isolated gate effect cannot explain18 rejected smaller amplitudes.

decision_advice.current_action: Keep the current registered run/settings unchanged and interpret unified frozen-endpoint results when available; this review does not authorize a new scientific job.
avoid_unsupported_explanations: Do not label zero acceptance simply as gates too strict.
Do not claim the observed candidate directions prove all directions in the model family are adverse.
Do not claim STE is the diagnosed root cause from these logs alone.
Do not infer the later REAL1 trajectory or complete teacher qualification from its first saved direction.
decision_advice.future_only_priority: First distinguish mean-H FIT optimization from every-H CHECK conjunction using the saved evidence. If a new diagnostic is separately registered, then test same-bank hard/STE directional agreement; require a legal REAL TRAIN expressivity result before adding the work-order restricted smooth residual.
future_comparison_stop_rules: Adverse hard directions under the existing policy: address direction/observation agreement before relaxing guards.
Native-pass but MC-unresolved cells: report uncertainty; do not call positive point estimates hidden success.
A demonstrated legal-TRAIN family residual, rather than rejected directions alone, is the prerequisite for expanding the mean family.

limitations.conditional_physics_identifiability: Unpaired acquisition/population ambiguity remains; canonicalQ preservation is a candidate restriction, not a verified physical truth.
limitations.exact_positive_T_values: No correctly pinned local tolerance payload was read. The same-basename local JSON hashes177479d5..., versus the executed config pinf33217e0...; it is excluded. Analysis uses persisted check booleans and saved candidate/current values.
limitations.uncertainty_scope: Saved repeated3MCSE is an internal selection rule, not a simultaneous confidence guarantee.
